fees.joining_note: A one-time joining fee of ₹499 is charged at the time of card issuance as per the bank's policy
fees.annual_note: The annual fee is charged every year and may be waived if you meet the bank's spending conditions.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 3.5% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currencyExamples (3.5%):₹100 → ₹3.5₹1,000 → ₹35₹10,000 → ₹350₹1,00,000 → ₹3,500
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount is charged on cash advances using the credit card, subject to a minimum of ₹500
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: A surcharge of 1% is applied to transactions made for booking railway tickets
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Additional ₹100 is charged if Minimum Amount Due remains unpaid for two consecutive cycles, continuing until cleared

rewards.redemption_options: This is a cashback card, and the earned cashback is adjusted directly in your monthly statement.
rewards.exclusions: Fuel, EMI Transactions, Wallet Load, Rent, Utility Bill Payments, Government Spends, Cash Advances, ATM Withdrawals, Jewellery
rewards.exclusion_spends: Fuel, EMI Transactions, Wallet Load, Rent, Utility Bill Payments, Government Spends, Cash Advances, ATM Withdrawals, Jewellery
